final_answer:
The AI model used to evaluate the generated reports was **Claude (Sonnet 4.6)**. This AI-assisted scoring protocol was employed to manage the practical constraints of evaluating 1,000 AI-generated reports while preserving scoring consistency and rubric fidelity [c1].
